blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Silver Valley

items.t: ALR bar on stratification: ALR status is per-parcel in this part of Maple Ridge. Where a parcel is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, its residences cannot be stratified — ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6, Strata Property Act s. 239 and Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1) — which is one reason the sub-area's large-lot edge produces freehold houses, not strata product. Check the Agricultural Land Commission's mapping for any specific lot.

blocks.text: Silver Valley home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

24 townhomes sold in Silver Valley with a median price of $805,000 (the middle half sold between $756,250 and $879,900), taking a median of 18 days to sell at 98.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $510 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $367 a month.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 condos and townhomes listed in Silver Valley. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Silver Valley?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Silver Valley had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Silver Valley a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: Silver Valley accounted for 12 of the 230 condos and townhomes sold across Maple Ridge from June to October 2026.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Silver Valley from June to October 2026?
